description: A microscope was packed away in a box that the crew did not know was there. No microscopy data was collected initially despite samples being available.
response: The Science Officer found and activated the microscope, including locating microscope oil for the 100x lens. Cyanobacteria were successfully imaged.
lesson: Request a full lab equipment inventory from the Mars Society before departure. Plan a 'discover and activate' step on Day 1 of lab operations — do not assume equipment is set up or functional.
pattern_tag: lab equipment discovery / activation on arrival
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.4 Scientific incidents, lines 683-688. Register Crew tag: 'C15'. Sol: not stated; placed early in the mission as lab-equipment 'discovery and activation' typically precedes first science operations. Confidence (A) rationale: named Science Officer, specific technical detail (100x lens, oil) — reads as a formal science/engineering report.
